enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Sleep. Turn onto back. Sleep. Turn to side. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, showering and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs over side. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush. Lower lid. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Turn off tap. Dry hands. Walk to shower. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Put on underwear. Put on pants. Put on shirt. Put on socks. Walk back to bathroom. Comb hair. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, toasting bread and eating a relaxed holiday breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out mug. Put tea bag in mug. Take bread from breadbox. Put slice in toaster. Push down lever. Wait. Kettle boils. Pour hot water into mug. Take toast out. Put on plate. Butter toast. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Finish breakfast.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching morning television and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Lean back. Cross legs. Watch TV. Change channel. Put remote down. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Get glass of water. Walk back. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up and vacuuming the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from sofa. Pick up magazines. Stack them. Put on shelf. Pick up cushions. Place on sofa. Pick up cups. Carry to kitchen. Return. Move coffee table. Walk to closet. Open closet. Take out vacuum cleaner. Unwind cord. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Move around furniture. Vacuum under sofa. Turn off vacuum. Unplug. Wind cord. Put vacuum back in closet. Close closet. Move coffee table back.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch, then washing up the dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out ingredients. Close fridge. Take cutting board. Take knife. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Plate food. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Stand up. Carry plate to sink. Rinse plate. Apply soap. Scrub plate. Rinse. Place in drying rack. Wash utensils. Dry hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to browse the news and plan personal errands, with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Press power button. Wait for boot. Log in. Open browser. Type news website. Scroll headlines. Click article. Read. Close article. Open calendar. Check dates. Type notes. Open email. Check messages. Close email. Shut down computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping, having a coffee and taking a walk in the local park
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Put on jacket. Pick up keys. Pick up wallet. Walk out door. Lock door. Walk to grocery store. Enter store. Pick up basket. Walk aisles. Select items. Put in basket. Go to checkout. Pay. Bag items. Leave store. Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Order coffee. Pay. Take coffee. Sit at table. Drink coffee. Leave cafe. Walk to park. Enter park. Walk along path. Sit on bench. Get up. Walk back home. Unlock door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking groceries and having a light afternoon snack
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Put grocery bags on counter. Open fridge. Take out items. Place in fridge. Close fridge. Open cupboard. Place items. Close cupboard. Take fruit from bowl. Wash fruit. Cut fruit. Eat fruit. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Strolling through the local market and browsing stalls on the public holiday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out door. Lock door. Walk to market. Enter market area. Walk along stalls. Stop at stall. Pick up item. Examine. Put down. Talk to vendor. Move to next stall. Pick up item. Buy item. Pay. Put in bag. Continue walking. Stop at another stall. Look at items. Move on. Walk back home. Unlock door. Enter.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, then cleaning the countertops
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out ingredients. Close fridge. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Plate food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Stand up. Carry plate to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher. Take cloth. Spray cleaner on counter. Wipe counter. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching television and playing video games
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up game controller. Turn on game console. Start game. Play game. Pause game. Put down controller. Watch TV. Pick up controller. Resume game. Play. Finish game. Turn off console. Watch TV. Change channel. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Rinse toothbrush. Put away toothbrush. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom. Change into pajamas.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and scrolling on the phone with the fan on to wind down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on fan. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Continue reading. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll through social media. Tap on post. Read. Scroll more. Lock phone. Put phone on nightstand. Lie down.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to other side. Sleep. Turn onto back. Sleep.
